technology_name: AN EFFERVESCENT TABLET FORMULATION BY A 3D PRINTING PROCESS AND METHOD OF PREPARATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional multi-stage wet granulation processes for manufacturing effervescent tablets require high structural additive binders, elevated operating expenses, and cause early moisture activation.
description: A simplified, single-nozzle 3D printing manufacturing technique utilizing a specialized compound ink formulation blended with polyethylene glycol 4000, polyethylene glycol 400, and a thickener agent to prevent early effervescence.
applications: Customized hospital point-of-care medication printing, fast-dissolving nutraceutical development, scalable single-dose medical kits, and custom patient dosage protocols.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
